units.source_text: “今天他净说些强人所难的话，寸步不让我离开他的身边。

en.t: Today he kept saying unreasonable things, and would not let me leave his side for even a moment.

units.source_text: 一会儿要解手，一会儿要翻身，一会儿又要喝茶抽烟。

en.t: One moment he wanted to relieve himself, the next he wanted to turn over, and then he wanted tea and a smoke.

units.source_text: 从早晨到现在，我还没回过一次家呢。”

en.t: From morning until now, I have not gone home even once.
